question: Does one explicit contract rule in the agent prompt ('refuse when the request cannot be carried out; never call an unrequired tool; never claim an unconfirmed action') raise the negative-group pass rate, without lowering it anywhere?
why: The v8 gate blocks on 16 negative-case deviations. Every one is agent behaviour, not tool behaviour: the tools refuse correctly. The frozen criteria are documentation; expected_tools plus the terminal type is the mechanical contract. This experiment tests the cheapest honest fix — one rule — against a frozen baseline.

B.difference: exactly one added system rule, listed in the diff of the two files

casesRationale: The disputed family: refusal expected with no call (001), empty tool set with substitution observed (002), declining a capability (005), rubric-disambiguation candidate (008), unavailable merchant offer (009).
design: 2 arms x 2 models x 5 cases x 5 runs, each cell a separate diagnostic ledger
grader: journey-grader v2, unchanged for both arms; dataset 8.0.0 unchanged; no case definition is edited by this experiment
primaryEndpoint: pass count on the 5 pre-registered cases, pooled across both models, per arm (max 50)

decisionRule.adoptB: pooled B - pooled A >= 5 passes (10 percentage points) AND no model regresses by more than 1 pass
decisionRule.otherwise: keep the baseline and report the experiment as negative or inconclusive; do not retune and re-run under the same registration id

blinding: The primary endpoint is mechanical (grader v2), so no human judgement enters it. Any qualitative review of terminal texts must be prepared from arm-stripped copies; no such review is part of this endpoint.
evidenceStore: webmcp/evals/experiments/neg-contract-v1/ — every run carries purpose=diagnostic and can never enter a release ledger (enforced by the runner, see attempt-journal.js and release-policy.js)
stoppingRule: All 100 journeys are run. No optional stopping, no peeking at partial results before the full collection.
notQualificationEvidence: This is a diagnostic campaign. Its records are excluded from every release fraction by purpose.
